summary: 5 V to 3.3 V power board with input/output connectors and power indicator LED.
purpose: Step down 5 V input to regulated 3.3 V output and provide a green power-indicator LED on the 3.3 V rail.
constraints: 3.3 V output must be regulated from 5 V input.
Green power-indicator LED must be connected to the 3.3 V rail with a current-limiting resistor for approximately 2 mA current.

required.detail: Green power-indicator LED on the 3.3 V rail
Current-limiting resistor for the green LED (target ~2 mA)
